Subject: Bedroom window repair – Flat 24, 150 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 7ZZ (Ref R/PM047-1)

Good afternoon,

This is an update to our email of 22 February about Flat 24, 150 Copperfield Walk.

The tenant has told us the blocked toilet has been sorted, so no plumber is needed. The only outstanding issue is the bedroom window, which isn't closing properly.

We'd like to send one of our contractors to inspect the window, repair it if it's a simple fix, and quote for anything more. We don't have a cost yet. If the repair needs more than a minor adjustment, we'll send you the quote for approval before any further work goes ahead.

Please reply APPROVE for us to send our contractor, or DECLINE if you'd rather use your own contractor. If you choose your own, please send us their details so we can arrange access with the tenant.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team

input.subject: Bedroom window – Flat 24, 150 Copperfield Walk (Ref R/PM047-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for letting us know the toilet has been fixed. We're glad that's sorted. We've told the landlord that only the bedroom window now needs attention, and we're waiting for their go-ahead to send a contractor. We'll be in touch as soon as we hear back.

In the meantime, could you tell us whether the window can still be shut and locked securely, or whether it's stuck open? If it's stuck open, please tell us which floor the flat is on. If the window can't be secured, please reply or call us straight away so we can treat it as urgent.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team
